guidance.inspection: Read the complete duty and identify its actor, object, mandatory action, and trigger. Termination, expiration, rejection, or conclusion can support the hypothesis; a request-only duty does not.

Determine whether every protected item requires the disclosing party's express designation. Contrast marking or identification rules with protection arising from reasonable understanding, circumstances, subject matter, or automatic inclusion; retain form-specific confirmation deadlines.

any_phrases: should know is treated as confidential

guidance.inspection: Read each independent-development permission or exclusion with its preamble. Preserve actor, proof, timing, and no-access or no-use conditions; reject prior possession, third-party provenance, and mere competitive-product language.

Find an operative permission or exception for the receiving party's employees. Retain need-to-know, purpose, undertaking, notice, and responsibility conditions; a recipient definition or unrelated employee mention is only a reading lead.

any_phrases: person to which disclosure is contemplated

guidance.inspection: Read ownership, reservation, licence, and no-grant provisions together. Decide whether rights in protected information are granted, accounting for express exceptions or limited licences; access and purpose-limited use alone are not rights grants.

Inspect nondisclosure of an agreement's existence or the existence, status, content, or terms of discussions and negotiations. Retain consent, audience, legal exceptions, governing preambles, and each independently responsive list item.

Identify obligations expressly continuing after termination, expiration, completion, abandonment, return, or destruction. Retain the affected duties, trigger, duration, endpoint, exceptions, and split text; reject severability and accrued-remedy clauses.

any_phrases: shall remain subject to the terms
held in compliance with the terms

guidance.inspection: Verify that legal, regulatory, governmental, subpoena, or court compulsion triggers notice by the receiving party to the disclosing party. Retain timing and protective-order steps; reject unauthorized-use notices and permission without notice.

Inspect personnel-solicitation restrictions for actor, employee or representative targets, duration, consent, covered contacts, and exceptions. Follow enumerated target classes, but reject proxy solicitation and unrelated standstill language.

Determine whether creating a copy is permitted, prohibited, or conditioned. Retain actor, object, purpose, quantity, consent, and exceptions; do not treat archival retention of an existing copy as permission to create one.

Read a retention permission or all-copies-return command with the return or destruction rule it qualifies. Verify the event, holder, material, purpose, duration, access limits, and continuing duties; distinguish permission from mere physical persistence.

any_phrases: no copies thereof shall be retained except

guidance.inspection: Read the operative protected-information definition and subject enumeration. Decide whether it is exclusively technical or also includes business, financial, marketing, personnel, contact, operational, or other nontechnical information; reject unrelated actor clauses.

Determine whether oral or verbal information belongs to the protected class and retain any designation or later-writing condition. Reject oral negotiation references and read written-only formulations for polarity.

any_phrases: irrespective of the form of communication

guidance.inspection: Determine whether information may be obtained from a source other than the disclosing party. Retain the exclusion or permission preamble and provenance, confidentiality-duty, knowledge, lawful-means, and timing conditions; reject independent development and unrelated dealings.

Find an operative permission, exception, or prohibition for nonemployee recipients. Retain class definitions only with disclosure or access language and preserve need-to-know, purpose, consent, and confidentiality conditions; employee-only permission may oppose the hypothesis.

Read operative use language for actor, protected object, stated purpose, exceptions, and polarity. Sole-purpose language or a ban on other uses supports limitation; access, disclosure, ownership, or licensing alone does not.

any_phrases: not to use exploit or employ

guidance.inspection: Inspect reverse engineering, decompilation, or disassembly language for actor, prohibited action, protected object, purpose, and exceptions. Unrelated product restrictions and general confidentiality duties do not settle the hypothesis; no hit is not a verdict.

Entail only when return or destruction is mandatory upon termination, expiration, rejection, conclusion, or ceasing interest. A request-only duty remains NotMentioned even if termination is addressed elsewhere; never join separate triggers. Retain actor, object, action, trigger, and governing preamble.

operations.rationale: The observed contrast establishes that a request-only return duty does not settle the termination-triggered hypothesis, while conclusion, ceasing-interest, and termination-linked duties do.

guidance.inspection: Entail only if every protected item must be expressly marked or identified by the disclosing party, including any oral-confirmation rule. Contradict when the definition expressly offers a non-identification alternative such as reasonable understanding, circumstances, or automatic inclusion. Do not infer either relation from a missing marking clause; retain the full alternatives.

any_phrases: information marked in writing as confidential
should know is treated as confidential

operations.rationale: This makes the universal quantifier decision-bearing and prevents both treating one designation route as universal and treating silence as its negation.

guidance.inspection: Entail when the recipient may independently develop or independently derive information without using, accessing, or referring to protected information. Retain the exclusion or permission preamble and proof conditions. Information derived from protected information, prior possession, third-party receipt, or mere competitive activity does not establish independent development.

operations.rationale: Adds the missed independently-derived formulation while directly excluding the unsupported derived-information inference observed on another contract.

guidance.inspection: Require an operative permission or exception for employees, internal staff, or receiving-party representatives—not a bare actor definition. Retain need-to-know, purpose, undertaking, notice, and responsibility conditions. Under the observed labels, an operative permission to a defined receiving-party representative class is sufficient; unrelated employee mentions are not.

any_phrases: internal information technology and management staff

operations.rationale: Addresses visible-but-rejected employee evidence and search misses for internal staff and receiving-party representative formulations.

guidance.inspection: Entail from an express no-right, no-license, ownership, or reservation provision concerning protected information. A limited right expressly carved out must be considered, but access, evaluation, review, or purpose-limited use alone is not a rights grant and cannot contradict the hypothesis. Retain independently redundant ownership and no-grant clauses.

operations.rationale: Prevents the repeated wrong relation that treated access or evaluation use as a license contradicting an express no-grant hypothesis.

guidance.inspection: Entail if an operative nondisclosure rule directly covers the agreement, its existence or terms, or discussions or negotiations. Coverage may arise by defining those subjects as Confidential Information plus a general confidentiality duty; retain both provisions. Compelled-disclosure procedure is not substitute evidence for the underlying secrecy duty.

any_phrases: agreement and the terms contained herein
fact that a meeting or discussion

operations.rationale: Finds definition-mediated secrecy that the parent missed and prevents citation of compelled-disclosure clauses as the decision-bearing prohibition.

guidance.inspection: Entail only from language continuing an identified obligation after termination, expiration, completion, abandonment, return, or destruction. Cite the continuation sentence, affected duty, duration, endpoint, and necessary preamble—not a retention exception alone. Reject a bare termination right or accrued-remedies clause.

operations.rationale: Improves acquisition of continuation wording and separates the governing continuation clause from retention items and unrelated termination text.

guidance.inspection: Entail when legal, regulatory, governmental, subpoena, court, or administrative compulsion requires the recipient to notify, inform, or consult the disclosing party. Retain the trigger, timing, recipient, and protective-order mechanism. Reject unauthorized-use notices and bare compelled-disclosure permission.

any_phrases: provide the disclosing party with prompt notice
after consultation with the other party

operations.rationale: Covers split and variant notice formulations missed by exact queries while preserving the compelled trigger test.

guidance.inspection: Entail only from an affirmative necessary-purpose copy exception or acknowledged automatic-copy circumstance. A prohibition on copying without consent, standing alone, is Contradiction under the observed labels; consent being imaginable is not affirmative permission. Retain actor, object, purpose, consent, quantity, and exceptions; archival retention is not creation.

operations.rationale: Corrects the recurring polarity error on consent-conditioned prohibitions while preserving affirmative operational exceptions and automatic-copy evidence.

guidance.inspection: Entail if an express exception permits specified material to remain after a return or destruction duty. Contradict if the operative rule requires return or destruction of all protected material or copies and supplies no retention exception. Otherwise use NotMentioned. Retain the governing return rule, exception, holder, purpose, access limits, duration, and continuing duties.

any_phrases: no copies thereof shall be retained except

operations.rationale: The training contrasts establish a reliable three-way test between express retention exceptions, blanket all-copy commands, and silence.

guidance.inspection: Contradict only when the protected-information definition expressly includes a nontechnical subject such as business, financial, marketing, customer, personnel, contact, or operational information. Generic breadth, form language, transaction references, or an auxiliary definition of all information does not alone prove nontechnical subject matter. Retain the definition and governing list introduction.

operations.rationale: Prevents unsupported contradiction from generic all-information language while retaining explicit nontechnical categories that consistently oppose the hypothesis.

guidance.inspection: Entail when the protected class expressly includes oral or verbal information, even if later writing or identification is required. A written-marking category without any oral statement is not a contradiction; it leaves the hypothesis unsettled. Reject oral negotiations and compelled oral questions unrelated to the definition.

any_phrases: irrespective of the form of communication
whether or not such information is also disclosed orally

operations.rationale: Clarifies that silence or a written category does not negate oral inclusion and preserves conditional oral coverage.

guidance.inspection: Entail from an exclusion or permission allowing information received or becoming available from someone other than the disclosing party, subject to lawful provenance and no confidentiality duty. Retain its preamble and knowledge, timing, and proof conditions. Information originally supplied by the disclosing party's vendors, or independent development, is not third-party acquisition.

any_phrases: becomes available to the receiving party

operations.rationale: Adds the missed available-from-others formulations and excludes the observed vendor-data provenance error.

guidance.inspection: Entail only from an operative disclosure or access permission for a nonemployee class; a class definition, marking rule, or unrelated mention is insufficient. Retain need-to-know, purpose, consent, undertaking, and responsibility conditions. An exclusive employee-only permission with no nonemployee exception contradicts; absence of permission is NotMentioned.

operations.rationale: Strengthens the operative-permission requirement, supplies inflection coverage, and states the employee-only contradiction supported by observed contrasts.

guidance.inspection: Entail from an operative rule limiting use of protected information to the agreement's stated purpose or forbidding other uses. Contradict when the contract affirmatively permits protected information or residuals for broader internal or any purposes. A copying exception, disclosure permission, ownership clause, or license clause alone does not decide use scope.

operations.rationale: Corrects both the broader-use contradiction and the unsupported inference from purpose-limited copying rather than use.
